verdict.rationale: An edge/cloud compute platform could plausibly ship a unified AI model gateway, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents VMs, Sprites, GPUs, MCP server hosting and credential brokering, but nothing describing a single endpoint that routes to hundreds of AI models. Running GPUs or self-hosting models are building blocks, not the gateway capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
